description: Pick the slip-case job card out of a bindery's workshop folder and report the greyboard thickness it specifies. DISTILL-CANARY-cbfe778f

files.README.md:
Ridgeway Bindery - workshop folder

Job cards are filed here once the boards are cut. The office keeps a copy of
every card until the run is invoiced, then the card moves to the loft.

turns.prompt: Ridgeway Bindery files one job card for every binding run. The card for the slip-case run in navy buckram gives the greyboard thickness in millimetres. What is that thickness? Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
